_about: Recipe pages taken down because another page is the same dish. Each old URL answers a permanent (301) redirect to the page that stays: .htaccess on the live host, _redirects (written by the build) and vercel.json elsewhere. tools/retired-recipes-check.js (part of npm run check) holds the three to this list. Never reuse a slug listed here for a different dish.

australian-cheese-and-vegemite-scrolls.reason: Same dish: scone-dough scrolls with Vegemite and cheddar. vegemite-scrolls was published first (8 October 2026).

fluffy-pancakes.reason: Same dish: fluffy American buttermilk pancakes. buttermilk-pancakes (Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes) was published first (5 September 2026).

sticky-date-cake.reason: Same dish: date sponge soaked with toffee sauce, same method and tin. sticky-date-pudding is the dish's usual name.

slow-cooker-split-pea-soup.reason: Same dish: split peas and ham hock on low in the slow cooker. slow-cooker-pea-and-ham-soup was published first (8 October 2026).
